- **Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)**: Would require cytopenias (at least two lineages), hyperferritinemia, hypofibrinogenemia, or hemophagocytosis on marrow — not supported by current labs (only mild anemia, normal platelets, no ferritin/fibrinogen reported).
